name: menu-m
title: Account menu · phone
note: One new row, last in You: Share Concert Crawl, with the QR tile in accent.

name: menu-d
title: Account menu · desktop
note: Same row in the popover, shown hovered.

name: sheet-m
title: Share sheet
note: The QR is a ticket: code above the perforation, who joined with it below. Share… opens the phone’s own sheet with the link and a line of text.

name: sheet-none-m
title: Share sheet · no one yet
note: Three empty seats say “room for people” without promising a number. The code never runs out.

name: fullscreen-m
title: Full screen
note: Opened by Full screen (tapping the code is a hidden shortcut, no icon). Always white at full contrast, whatever the theme. Keeps the screen awake until Done. Web pages can’t set brightness, so the foot asks for it.

name: sheet-320
title: Share sheet · at 320
note: The QR drops to 196px; the link stays on one line.

name: sheet-d
title: Share dialog · desktop
note: The live BottomSheet becomes a centered dialog. Copy link leads; Share… shows only where the browser has it; no Full screen.

name: loading-m
title: Making your invite
note: First open makes the code. The ticket keeps its size, so nothing jumps when the QR lands.

name: copied-m
title: Link copied
note: Live string. The press turns success for 2 seconds, then goes back.

name: share-failed-m
title: Share failed
note: The phone refused (not a cancel: a cancel says nothing). Points to Copy link.

name: error-m
title: Couldn’t make the code
note: Network or server. Try again sits in the QR’s place; the presses wait.

name: off-m
title: Code turned off
note: An admin revoked this person’s code (it ended up somewhere public). The QR falls back to the plain site, which is the waitlist before launch.

name: open-m
title: After launch
note: No invite needed: a plain link to concertcrawl.app, no stub, a different title. Same row, same sheet.

name: signed-out-m
title: After launch · signed out
note: Guests can share too once there is no gate. The row goes first in App. Before launch it is absent signed out.

name: unfurl-d
title: Link preview
note: What a pasted /i/ link unfurls as. One image for every code: it names nobody, so it can be cached.

name: invite-from-m
title: Invite page · from a friend
note: The existing “from a link or QR” board, with the sharer’s first name in the line. Optional: see question 2.

name: parts-d
title: Parts · Electric
note: Every state of the ticket, the row and the presses.
